plans.idea: Brand-to-action left-to-right run: logo opens the strip, the glowing circle and the bottle sit together as one product cluster, then a wide text block, then a full-height CTA button anchored at the right edge.

Headline-first leaderboard: the message leads from the left edge at full height, the product pair follows as visual proof, and the logo signs off right before the CTA, as in a classic banner end-frame.
Keep the original's split: brand plus copy on the left half, and the product imagery moved right so it sits next to the CTA, making the bottle the visual bridge to 'Shop Now'.
